args.name: Assess an unfamiliar food sample
args.function: Provide a learnable, evidence-producing method to examine a small owned food sample for nutritional usefulness, toxicity, and any preparation required before consumption. Report only what the actual method can establish, with unresolved uncertainties explicit.
args.conditions: I am beside a mature hazelnut plant observed with five units at tick 9. Its visible state did not establish edibility. Berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 are known; hazelnut nutrition, toxicity, and preparation needs are unknown. I intend to gather one sample and retain my berries.
args.inputs: An owned food sample; additional tools or materials only if the feasible method requires them and they are actually acquired.
args.costs: Method, time, sample consumption, and equipment costs are unknown. Specify these before use; do not assume laboratory tools or other equipment.
args.effects: Enable actual bounded food-assessment trials with measured findings and stated limits. No automatic knowledge of hidden composition, safety guarantee, health benefit, or mastery from requesting.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.
